result.instructions:
Shared context graphs: search with context_flow_get; choose graph_list. Before node/relation writes, get agent_id via agent_register; reuse registration keys per account/OAuth client. Registration grants no identity proof/access.
graph_update/node_update need current expected_version; reread on conflict. Keys use only ASCII letters, digits, _ or -. request_id is an optional per-write key: same key+args replay for 24 hours; new key=new write. Lost key/uncertain unkeyed result: reread. Internal failure: no relogin.
Server auth/grade/agent checks apply; annotations/host approval grant no access. Delete/permissions/teams are web-only.

tools.description: Register an agent. Reusing an active key returns the same ID; revoked keys stay revoked.

registration_key.description: Reusable key: 16-128 ASCII letters, digits, _ or -. Never include credentials or content.

tools.name: agent_register

tools.description: Retrieve a flat context flow for a task. Channel failures and budget/hop truncation may produce normal partial results.

as_of.description: Query time in UTC, not historical restoration. Defaults to now.

budget.description: Response body character budget, not tokens. Default and maximum depend on plan.

tools.name: context_flow_get

tools.description: Create a graph owned by the authenticated account.
tools.name: graph_create

tools.description: Get graph metadata, current version and entry summary.
tools.name: graph_get

tools.description: List accessible active graphs by recent activity.

cursor.description: Reuse the returned cursor unchanged. Omit or empty for the first page.

grade_filter.description: Filter by current grade. Empty and duplicate values allowed.

page_size.description: Page size; default and maximum depend on plan.

tools.name: graph_list

tools.description: Update name, description or entry summary using the current expected_version.

description.description: New description; omit to keep, empty to clear.

entry_context_id.description: Active entry summary; omit to keep, null to clear.

name.description: New nonblank name; omit to keep.

tools.name: graph_update

tools.description: Create a source, derived node or event. A creation_status=existing_deleted result cannot be active evidence. Connect events with previous_event_id or relation_confirm.

body.description: Body; no NUL, whitespace-only allowed. Stored and indexed verbatim.

confidence_state.description: Confidence state: required for opinion; forbidden otherwise.

conversation_id.description: Immutable nonblank conversation ID for sources and events. Sources require channel=conversation and turn_index.

derived_from.description: Immutable source/derived evidence references in the same graph.

event_end.description: Event end in UTC; omit for ongoing.

event_start.description: Event start in UTC. Source members must occur within the event interval.

judgment_input.description: Judgment input; omit to record validated arguments.

layer.description: Required by layer: source: source_ref, occurred_at, origin_kind; derived: derived_from, derivation_kind, evidence_state; event: member_refs, event_start. Reject fields belonging to other layers.

member_refs.description: Source/derived members in the same graph; no events.

navigation_refs.description: Immutable summary navigation, not evidence: events, summaries or sources in the same graph. No self-reference.

occurred_at.description: Original occurrence time in UTC, distinct from recording time.

previous_event_id.description: Event only: active previous event in the same graph and conversation. Requires conversation_id. Atomically creates confirmed precedes; not stored as a property.

source_ref.description: Source deduplication key. Returns existing sources even if discarded/deleted; never restores automatically.

locator.description: Original URI; the server does not fetch it.

summary_scope.description: Summary scope: required for summary; forbidden otherwise.

supersedes_context_id.description: Prior derived node in the same lineage. Edge: new to prior; separate from evidence.

turn_index.description: Immutable conversation source turn order; paired with conversation_id.

valid_from.description: Derived validity start in UTC; omit for open start.

valid_to.description: Derived validity end in UTC; omit for open end.

tools.name: node_create

tools.description: Soft-discard a node. Reject repeated discard; no cascade.

judgment_input.description: Judgment input; omit to record validated arguments.

tools.name: node_discard

tools.description: Get a subgraph via confirmed edges. Truncation is a normal partial result.

direction.description: Default both. out follows derived to evidence/prior, summary to navigation, event to members/relation targets; in reverses.

hops.description: Hop count; default 0 returns only the start. Maximum depends on plan.

traversal_filter.description: Edge filter; omit or empty for all. Duplicates allowed.

tools.name: node_get

tools.description: Restore an operation-discarded node. Restore web deletions on the web. Reject already active nodes.

judgment_input.description: Judgment input; omit to record validated arguments.

tools.name: node_restore

tools.description: Update mutable derived/event fields or record a keep judgment. Sources are immutable; correct them with new sources. To change derived evidence/kind, create a replacement with supersedes_context_id. Omitted fields stay unchanged.

body.description: Body; no NUL, whitespace-only allowed. Stored and indexed verbatim.

confidence_state.description: New confidence for an opinion derived node.

event_end.description: New event end in UTC; null for ongoing.

event_start.description: New event start in UTC; source members must occur within the interval.

judgment_input.description: Judgment input; omit to record validated arguments.

management_action.description: Default update. keep checks the current version and records judgment without mutable fields.

valid_from.description: New derived validity start in UTC; null to clear.

valid_to.description: New derived validity end in UTC; null to clear.

tools.name: node_update

tools.description: Confirm/reconfirm relations between active events in one graph. Use derived_from/member_refs for source/derived links. Failure does not undo prior node creation.

from_context_id.description: Active event at the starting endpoint in the same graph. For precedes/causes, it must not start after the target event.

judgment_input.description: Judgment input; omit to record validated arguments.

relation_type.description: precedes: earlier to later; causes: cause to effect; part_of: part to whole; relates_to: undirected. Reconfirming the same graph/type/endpoints returns current state.

to_context_id.description: Active target event in the same graph. For part_of, its interval must contain the source event.

tools.name: relation_confirm

tools.description: Discard an event relation. Reject repeated discard; restore with relation_confirm.

judgment_input.description: Judgment input; omit to record validated arguments.

relation_id.description: Relation UUIDv7 to discard; no repeated discard.

tools.name: relation_discard

tools.description: List event relations by state/type, ordered by descending relation_id.

cursor.description: Reuse the returned cursor unchanged. Omit or empty for the first page.

page_size.description: Page size; default and maximum depend on plan.

state_filter.description: State filter; empty and duplicate values allowed.

type_filter.description: Type filter; empty and duplicate values allowed.

tools.name: relation_list
